page_note: Page divides clearly into two units. The first half (segments 0-16) is a hortatory-pastoral discourse on works, judgment, and the Savior's saying about heart and treasure (a Gospel citation introduced by 'According to the manner that the Savior said' — a 3rd-century Manichaean editorial citation vehicle). The second half opens chapter 90 'Concerning the Ten Ways,' framed by an Elect questioning the Apostle, but containing genuine cosmological substrate teaching about the Ten Ways drawing forth from the Zone — four ways of light ascending to life, others going to Gehenna via the Error. The substrate teaching here is the cosmological structure of post-mortem soul-paths — a Persian/Iranian psychopomp scheme. The disciple's quote of prior teaching (segs 24-31) preserves substrate verbatim.
